title: proposal
description: The chief's proposal to the owner after a board run, with the items it adds to TODO.HUMAN.md.

title.description: A short title for the proposal.

id.description: A stable question id, as TODO.HUMAN.md uses it.

question.description: The exact question or action for the owner.

options.description: The options the owner chooses from; empty for a one-time step.

waits.description: The milestone or order that waits on the answer.

human_items.description: Items for TODO.HUMAN.md; empty when the owner need not act.
